articles.title: Alaska Landslide Sent a Tsunami 1,580 Feet Up a Mountain
articles.summary: Scientists say an Alaska landslide made the second-highest tsunami on record, and warning signs appeared days before.

articles.title: Scientists Track Down Missing Matter Hiding Around Galaxies
articles.summary: Flashes of radio waves helped scientists find faint gas clouds that may hold some of the universe's missing ordinary matter.

articles.title: A Scientist Tests Tattoo Ink That Can Disappear and Come Back
articles.summary: Engineers made tattoo ink that turns clear under UV light and gets its color back in visible light.
